title: Tax Treatment
description: Tax treatment of a price amount.

inclusion.description: Whether the amount includes tax (e.g. VAT, GST) as resolved for the market. Well-known values: `included` (tax is part of the amount), `excluded` (tax is added downstream), `not_applicable` (no tax applies to this amount). Platforms MUST treat an unrecognized value as if `tax` were absent.
